meta.rationale: Your computer as a transit map: every app is a station, the lines are how things connect. Tap a station to go there.
meta.theme-about: subway map: a full-screen canvas of a clean transit diagram on off-white (Harry Beck style: thick coloured lines at 0/45/90 degrees, round white station markers with black rings, interchange pills where lines cross, a river in pale blue), each app a station with its name in bold sans type beside it, the station under the pointer fills with colour, clicking it opens the app; a line legend and a departures board with the time in the corner. Graphic, orderly, urban. (#map, #board)

desktop.canvas: local stations, hot = {}, nil function draw(w, h, t) g.rect(0, 0, w, h, "#f4f1ea") g.poly({0, h * 0.62, w * 0.3, h * 0.58, w * 0.5, h * 0.7, w * 0.75, h * 0.64, w, h * 0.72, w, h * 0.8, w * 0.75, h * 0.72, w * 0.5, h * 0.78, w * 0.3, h * 0.66, 0, h * 0.7}, "#cfe3f2") local u = math.min(w / 16, h / 9) local function P(x, y) return x * u, y * u end local lines = { {"#dc241f", {{2, 2}, {5, 2}, {7, 4}, {11, 4}, {13, 6}}}, {"#0019a8", {{3, 7}, {5, 5}, {7, 4}, {7, 2}}}, {"#00782a", {{9, 7}, {9, 5}, {11, 4}, {14, 4}}}, {"#ffd300", {{2, 5}, {5, 5}, {9, 5}, {11, 7}}}, } for _, l in ipairs(lines) do for k = 1, #l[2] - 1 do local ax, ay = P(l[2][k][1], l[2][k][2]) local bx, by = P(l[2][k + 1][1], l[2][k + 1][2]) g.line(ax, ay, bx, by, l[1], 12) g.circle(bx, by, 6, l[1]) end end local spots = {{5, 2}, {7, 4}, {11, 4}, {5, 5}, {9, 5}, {13, 6}, {3, 7}, {9, 7}, {2, 2}, {14, 4}, {11, 7}} local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() stations, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do local s = spots[i] if not s then break end local x, y = P(s[1], s[2]) stations[#stations + 1] = {x = x, y = y, name = a.name, id = a.id, big = (i == 2 or i == 3 or i == 5)} end for _, s in ipairs(stations) do if over and (px - s.x) ^ 2 + (py - s.y) ^ 2 < 26 * 26 then hot = s.id end end for _, s in ipairs(stations) do local r = s.big and 16 or 12 g.circle(s.x, s.y, r + 4, "#111111") g.circle(s.x, s.y, r, s.id == hot and "#dc241f" or "#ffffff") g.text(s.x + r + 10, s.y - 26, s.name, "#111111", s.big and 19 or 16, "Outfit") end local L = {{"#dc241f", "Central"}, {"#0019a8", "Piccadilly"}, {"#00782a", "District"}, {"#ffd300", "Circle"}} for i, l in ipairs(L) do g.rect(40, h - 170 + i * 28, 46, 10, l[1]) g.text(98, h - 178 + i * 28, l[2], "#111111", 15, "Outfit") end end function click(x, y) for _, s in ipairs(stations) do if (x - s.x) ^ 2 + (y - s.y) ^ 2 < 26 * 26 then return "open:" .. s.id end end end
